page_title: ETI 1-6 PSG | St Etienne v PSG 29/03/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+4' The match has just finished.
90' 3 additional min. will be played.
90' Substitution. Dennis Appiah (St Etienne) has come on for Yvann Macon.
90' 1 - 6 Goal! Bradley Barcola feeds Ibrahim Mbaye (PSG), who taps the ball into an empty net. He makes it 1:6.
88' Jeremy Stinat blows his whistle for a foul after Louis Mouton (St Etienne) hacks down one of his opponents.
87' Pierre Ekwah (St Etienne) pulls the trigger and strikes the ball towards goal from long-range, but his effort is blocked by one of the defenders.
82' Corner kick. PSG will have an opportunity.
81' A horde of players are waiting inside the penalty area for a cross from the corner, but Mickael Nade (St Etienne) takes it short.
78' We are about to witness a subsitution. Ibrahima Wadji (St Etienne) for Lucas Stassin.
78' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Irvin Cardona leaves the pitch and Aimen Moueffek (St Etienne) comes on.
78' Luis Enrique decides to make a substitution. Goncalo Ramos will be replaced by Ibrahim Mbaye (PSG).
78' The referee signals a substitution. Presnel Kimpembe (PSG) is brought on as a substitute for Lucas Beraldo.

77' What a great touch by Bradley Barcola (PSG)! He picks up a precise pass inside the box and immediately produces a shot towards the net. Unfortunately for him, his bullet only crashes against the crossbar.
74' Yvann Macon (St Etienne) sends a quick through ball into space for his teammate who is lurking close to the offside line, but one of the defenders intercepts and clears the danger.
73' Ousmane Dembele (PSG) takes the corner with a short pass.
72' NO PENALTY! Referee Jeremy Stinat has quickly reversed his decision to award a penalty after a VAR review. The St Etienne players are incensed.
71' The referee isn't 100% sure if it's a penalty to St Etienne, he's going to review using VAR.

71' Nuno Mendes (PSG) carelessly slides into the feet of his opponent and he'll be lucky to avoid punishment. Jeremy Stinat blows for the foul but keeps his cards in his pocket on this occasion. It's a penalty! Great chance to score for St Etienne!
69' Nuno Mendes (PSG) has an effort from distance but it's blocked.
69' Ousmane Dembele (PSG) rolls the ball short to a teammate from the corner instead of sending a cross into the box.
68' Jeremy Stinat shows a yellow card to Yvann Macon (St Etienne) for his blatant foul.
66' 1 - 5 Desire Doue (PSG) makes a great solo run and pulls the trigger from inside the box, beating Gautier Larsonneur with a strike under the crossbar. He makes it 1:5.
64' Luis Enrique has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Ousmane Dembele (PSG) replacing Khvicha Kvaratskhelia.
64' Substitution. Willian Pacho makes his way off the pitch and Nuno Mendes (PSG) comes on as his replacement.
63' Benjamin Old (St Etienne) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Zuriko Davitashvili.
63' Eirik Horneland prepares a substitution. Florian Tardieu is replaced by Louis Mouton (St Etienne).
62' 1 - 4 It's 1:4! Bradley Barcola feeds Joao Neves (PSG) inside the box, who is unmarked and buries the ball in the bottom left corner.
60' Khvicha Kvaratskhelia (PSG) is able to continue to play.
58' Khvicha Kvaratskhelia (PSG) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
57' Substitution. Warren Zaire-Emery will be replaced by Vitinha (PSG).
57' The total number of attempts is 6:15. The shots on goal statistics – 2:7.
55' Khvicha Kvaratskhelia (PSG) fires a strong shot to the middle of the goal and the save is unexpectedly difficult for Gautier Larsonneur.
53' 1 - 3 GOAL! Desire Doue (PSG) gets to the ball on the edge of the box after a huge mistake by an opponent and slams it into the back of the net. He makes it 1:3.
52' What a chance that is! Desire Doue (PSG) finds himself in a promising position after receiving a pass on the edge of the box. His attempt goes just over the bar.
52' This corner kick is taken with a short pass by Khvicha Kvaratskhelia (PSG).

52' Bradley Barcola (PSG) finds himself in space on the edge of the box and smashes a glorious looking effort towards the right side of the goal, but Gautier Larsonneur thwarts him with a great two-handed save. The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to PSG.

50' 1 - 2 GOAL! A terrible mistake leads to a goal. The defender ends up losing possession, allowing Khvicha Kvaratskhelia (PSG) to pick up the ball before slotting it into the back of the net to make it 1:2.
48' Goncalo Ramos (PSG) receives a well-played pass inside the penalty area and shoots. His effort sails well wide of the left post.
48' A clever short pass gives Khvicha Kvaratskhelia (PSG) a clear goal scoring opportunity, but he fluffs his lines and rifles the ball well wide of the right post.
46' The second half gets underway.
45+4' Jeremy Stinat blows his whistle to signal the end of the first-half action.
45+4' Matvey Safonov pulls off a great save to deny Lucas Stassin (St Etienne), who makes himself some space inside the box and unleashes a quick shot to the right side of the goal.
45+2' Desire Doue (PSG) aims for the middle of the goal, but that's an easy job for the goalkeeper. It will take more than that to test him!
45' The fourth official shows 3 min. of added time.
44' The linesman raises his flag as one of the players from St Etienne was in an offside position.
43' 1 - 1 GOAL! That’s a perfect strike from the spot by Goncalo Ramos (PSG) into the top right hand corner, giving goalkeeper Gautier Larsonneur no chance!
42' Goncalo Ramos (PSG) is heading towards the penalty spot to take it.
41' Poor challenge! Florian Tardieu (St Etienne) is penalised for tripping and Jeremy Stinat blows his whistle. PENALTY! One of the players from PSG is about to take a penalty kick.

39' It's unbelievable, Goncalo Ramos (PSG) blows a huge opportunity! He is totally unmarked and fires a first-time shot to the bottom left corner from a few yards out, but Gautier Larsonneur reacts superbly to keep the ball out.
36' The resulting corner from Khvicha Kvaratskhelia (PSG) comes to nothing.
34' Desire Doue (PSG) breaks past challenges inside the box, but puts too much pace on his pass to Lucas Hernandez. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for St Etienne.
32' Khvicha Kvaratskhelia (PSG) sends a wonderful cross from the corner kick. However, the defence works perfectly to clear the ball and avert the threat.
30' Desire Doue almost gets into in a promising position, but the through ball by Bradley Barcola (PSG) from just inside the box is intercepted by one of the defending players.
29' Fabian Ruiz (PSG) receives a reproachful look from Bradley Barcola. He latches on to his pass, but the effort from the edge of the box sails high over the crossbar.
26' Benjamin Bouchouari (St Etienne) gives the referee no choice but to show him a yellow card.
25' Jeremy Stinat interrupts the game for a tactical foul by Desire Doue (PSG).
22' Good play from Lucas Beraldo (PSG) gives him some space for the shot from distance, but it's lacking accuracy and goes well wide of the left post.
22' Desire Doue (PSG) attempts to find Goncalo Ramos with a delicate little through ball from inside the box, but one of the defending players makes a timely intervention.
19' Fabian Ruiz (PSG) receives a good pass and from just outside the box he unleashes a promising strike, but the shot is blocked by the defender.
19' Desire Doue (PSG) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
14' Zuriko Davitashvili (St Etienne) decides to speed play up with a short corner kick.
12' Half-chance! Bradley Barcola (PSG) plays a pass into the box, but Gautier Larsonneur reacts well to snuff out the attack.
11' Total attempts – 3:0. The number of shots on goal at present is 1:0.

9' 1 - 0 A perfect lofted pass from Zuriko Davitashvili finds Lucas Stassin (St Etienne), who jumps highest and steers a close-range header into the right side of the goal. His effort was both strong and precise, and Matvey Safonov had no chance of stopping that. 1:0.
9' Lucas Stassin is not given a chance to finish after receiving a sweet pass by Irvin Cardona (St Etienne).
8' Desire Doue (PSG) jumps into a tackle and Jeremy Stinat signals a foul. St Etienne have a free kick.
5' Zuriko Davitashvili (St Etienne) gets on the end of a good pass and from mid-range he unleashes a decent strike, but the shot is blocked by the defender.
4' Referee Jeremy Stinat sees the trip by Desire Doue (PSG) and doesn't hesitate to blow his whistle.
3' St Etienne take a short corner kick.
3' The ball is cleared after Zuriko Davitashvili (St Etienne) attempted to dribble past an opposing player. The linesman makes the right call and St Etienne will have a corner.
1' The referee blows his whistle and we are underway.
St Etienne will kick-off.
Jeremy Stinat got the nomination for today's game and will try his best to be a fair judge and not make any mistakes.
Show lineups The starting XIs were already announced and you can go through them in the Lineups section.
Show lineups
